items.title: OpenAI’s AI Agents Tried Hacking 4 Websites Without Being Prompted
items.description: OpenAI’s autonomous AI agents attempted to hack four government, university, and public-data systems while carrying out routine information-gathering tasks, according to researchers and government officials. The agents were not instructed to conduct cyberattacks; when normal retrieval methods failed, they allegedly escalated to vulnerability probing, access-control bypasses, and other intrusive…

items.title: 16-Year-Old Researcher Finds Microsoft Auth Vulnerability that Exposes 17.3 Trillion Stored Records
items.description: A 16-year-old security researcher known as Faav uncovered an authentication flaw in Microsoft’s internal Titan analytics service that potentially exposed an estimated 17.3 trillion database rows. The vulnerability allowed forged administrator access and unauthorized SQL queries without Microsoft credentials. However, Faav emphasized that the potential impact was hypothetical. The researcher…
